subject: Academica Health — feature acceleration and commit request
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Turner <sara.turner@academicahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Feature acceleration ask: Academica Health Q4 close — residency + audit export

Team — quick summary from this morning's call with Academica ( Sara on cc ). They are at final procurement but have two non-negotiable technical asks that are gating sign-off: 

1) Customer-managed key (KMS) support for model residency (they need to bring their own CMK for encryption of model payloads & logs).
2) Deterministic audit export: daily compressed audit exports (retention 7y) with object-level trace IDs they can ingest into their GRC systems.

Context: this is a $1.2M ARR first-year deal with a 24-month committed term. They’ve signaled willingness to accept a timed EAP and pay for a short-term dedicated reservation if we can give a firm delivery window (ideally <4 weeks for an initial, scoped delivery). Legal will still run a short review but the security questions we attached were the primary blocker.

Attachments: Academica_SOW_v3.pdf, Academica_Security_Questions.xlsx

Asks for Product/Eng: can we scope a minimal first-delivery that satisfies their procurement requirements (CMK + daily audit export with basic schema) and a clear next-steps plan for full retention/streaming export? If we can commit to a narrow deliverable in the 2–4 week window, Sales can push for signature with a one-time implementation fee.

Thanks,
Chloe
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Feature acceleration ask: Academica Health Q4 close — residency + audit export

Chloe — thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. High level technical constraints:

- CMK for residency: we have the plumbing for customer-managed keys in the private control plane, but exposing it to hosted model residency (short-term dedicated pools) requires a small auth flow and KMS binding logic. Rough effort: 5–8 dev days including test infra and 2 SRE days to bake deployment runbooks.
- Deterministic daily audit export: we can materialize daily exports from the trace pipeline as ndjson blobs. Basic schema and compression is straightforward; retention policies are primarily a storage + index decision. Rough effort: 3–5 dev days + 1 infra day.

Risks: cross-team test coverage for encrypted artifacts and KMS rotation edge-cases, plus we need product sign-off on the minimum schema for the export (fields, PII redaction rules).

If we are scoped to an MVP (CMK bind + daily audit dump with a fixed, documented schema and manual rotation instructions), I think this is doable in a 3-week sprint if we pull an eng lead (Jonas) and 1 product PM to own acceptance criteria. Otherwise a full production roll (automated rotation, per-object policy) is a 8–12 week project.

Can we get a prioritized list of acceptance criteria from Sales/Legal/Customer? That will determine whether we do an MVP or go full prod.

— Dev (on behalf of Runtime)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Feature acceleration ask: Academica Health Q4 close — residency + audit export

Quick product/SG workaround that might help while Eng scopes the work:

- Offer a temporary dedicated pool with limited model affinity and a contractual obligation for Academica to use a customer-managed KMS for exported artifacts (we currently support this in our Dedicated offering). That gets them cryptographic control immediately while we ship the hosted-binding work.
- For audit export, we can provide a scheduled export job that zips daily logs and drops them in a customer S3 (or Secure Transfer) location — needs a one-off config and acceptance that it's not yet automated into their GRC flow.

Commercial levers: we can attach a $25k implementation fee + a 6-week dedicated reservation at an up-charge which covers the SRE time to configure and the priority commit from Eng. This is palatable to them per the call.

Sales ask: Chloe — if we get commitment to the implementation fee + reservation, will Legal/Procurement sign faster? If yes I’d propose we scope MVP (Dev's 3-week) and kick off immediately with a stubbed deployment runbook.

— Ben (Solutions Engineering)

From: Sara Turner <sara.turner@academicahealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Feature acceleration ask: Academica Health Q4 close — residency + audit export

Chloe/Ben — thanks for the proposals. Legal is okay with the implementation fee model if we get a binding delivery window. Key asks from our side:

- Initial CMK binding and a documented KMS rotation procedure within 21 business days.
- Daily compressed audit export dropped to our secure S3 with a manifest (schema attached in the security worksheet). Initial retention of 7 years is negotiable if we get export guarantees.

If Redwood can commit to an initial scoped deliverable in <= 3 weeks and provide a dated runbook for KMS rotation, we will route for signature this week and expedite the PO. Please confirm timeline so we can lock internal approvals.

Sara Turner
Head of IT Security | Academica Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Feature acceleration ask: Academica Health Q4 close — residency + audit export

Thanks everyone — decision summary and recommended path: 

1) We will accept a scoped MVP for this deal: CMK binding to hosted residency + daily audit export (ndjson, gzipped) to customer S3. Scope excludes automated KMS rotation and per-object policy enforcement — those will be Phase 2.

2) Resource commitment: Jonas will lead implementation (Dev + one engineer), estimated calendar 3 weeks from kickoff to initial delivery, with an SRE handover and a runbook.

3) Commercial terms: Sales should secure the $25k implementation fee + a 6-week dedicated reservation to compensate for priority lane and SRE runbook work. This mitigates risk and gives Legal a commercial anchor.

4) Acceptance criteria checklist (Sales to confirm with customer):
   - CMK binding verified in staging
   - Daily audit export delivered to nominated S3 with manifest schema v1 (fields: timestamp, trace_id, request_id, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, redaction_flag)
   - Runbook with KMS bind and manual rotation steps published in private Confluence space

Chloe — please confirm customer acceptance of implementation fee + reservation and ping Legal to start the expedited PO. If Sales pushes for an earlier delivery (<=2 weeks), we will need additional eng-headcount or to cut acceptance criteria further.

I'll create a short JIRA epic and tie the acceptance criteria to it (link to follow).

— Marissa
Sr. PM, Enterprise
marissa.cole@redwood.com
